title: PT3 — PAGASA & PHIVOLCS Awareness Brochure
summary: Create an awareness brochure promoting the importance of PAGASA and PHIVOLCS to your local community, emphasizing hazard preparedness and DRRM.
instructions:
Your task is to create an awareness brochure for your local community that explains the roles of PAGASA and PHIVOLCS in protecting Filipinos from natural hazards. You will:

  1. Design a brochure (physical trifold, PDF, or digital) with at least 6 panels.
  2. Cover PAGASA's role: typhoon tracking, rainfall warnings, storm surge alerts, heat index advisories, El Niño/La Niña monitoring.
  3. Cover PHIVOLCS' role: volcano monitoring, earthquake detection, tsunami warnings, geohazard maps, alert levels.
  4. Include practical DRRM guidance for the community:
    • What to do before, during, and after a typhoon
    • What to do before, during, and after an earthquake
    • How to prepare a Go Bag
    • Where to find evacuation centers and hazard maps
  5. Include emergency hotlines and websites:
    • PAGASA: bagong.pagasa.dost.gov.ph
    • PHIVOLCS: phivolcs.dost.gov.ph
    • NDRRMC: ndrrmc.gov.ph
    • Local barangay DRRM hotline
  6. Use visuals — icons, hazard symbols, diagrams, and clear headings. Aim for easy-to-read, accessible language for all community members.
  7. Distribute or present the brochure to at least 3 people (family, classmates, or neighbors) and document the sharing (photo or short note).
  8. Reflect on why public awareness of PAGASA and PHIVOLCS matters for your community's safety.

Format: Submit as PDF or image (trifold brochure). Include a brief write-up describing how you shared it.
requirements: Trifold brochure (physical or digital) with at least 6 panels
PAGASA's role clearly explained (typhoons, rainfall, storm surge, heat index, El Niño)
PHIVOLCS' role clearly explained (volcanoes, earthquakes, tsunamis, geohazard maps)
Practical DRRM guidance for typhoons and earthquakes
Go Bag checklist and evacuation info
Shared or presented to at least 3 people
Personal reflection on the importance of public awareness

rubric.criterion: Accuracy of PAGASA and PHIVOLCS information
Clarity and readability for community audience
Inclusion of hotlines, websites, and Go Bag info
